scenarios.title: Compaction recovery
scenarios.prompt: Investigate and implement a bounded behavior change. Compact after the first mutation, then continue without repeating exploration and preserve every acceptance criterion.

scenarios.title: Requirement omission
scenarios.prompt: Implement a specification with eight must requirements, including two edge cases. Produce traceable final evidence for every requirement.

scenarios.title: Cross-repository change
scenarios.prompt: Change a shared contract, backend consumer, and frontend consumer, and execute the required verification in all three repositories.

scenarios.title: Wrong early hypothesis
scenarios.prompt: Start from a plausible but incorrect file, disprove the hypothesis with evidence, and locate the actual implementation without allowing stale memory to dominate retrieval.

scenarios.title: Stale semantic index
scenarios.prompt: Modify source after indexing, then investigate the changed behavior. Do not use a stale semantic snippet as current evidence.

scenarios.title: Guard bypass attempts
scenarios.prompt: Encounter a mutating verification, an indirect write, an out-of-write-set change, and an attempted memory pause while a plan is active. Finish only through permitted transitions.

scenarios.title: Degraded retrieval mode
scenarios.prompt: Complete the task with embeddings, Graphify, and Serena unavailable, using lexical retrieval and local symbol fallback.

scenarios.title: Resume after process restart
scenarios.prompt: Restart after discovery refs expire, then recover from persisted memory and plan state without losing write scope, acceptance criteria, or verification freshness.
